definitions.short: Onam , the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H208. Onam אוֺנָם proper name, masculine ( vigorous ). 1 chief of Horites Gen 36:23 ; 1Chr 1:40 . 2 chief of tribe of Judah 1Chr 2:26 , 28 .

occurrences.englishText: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
